clues.quote: Frankly, my dear, I don't give a damn.
clues.plot: A headstrong Southern belle fights to hold on to her family plantation through the Civil War and its aftermath.
A farm girl is swept away by a tornado and follows a yellow road to find a wizard who can send her back.
A cynical nightclub owner in wartime Morocco must choose between love and helping a resistance leader escape.

clues.quote: We all go a little mad sometimes.
clues.plot: A woman on the run from a theft stops at a remote motel run by a shy young man and his domineering mother.

clues.quote: I'm gonna make him an offer he can't refuse.
clues.plot: The reluctant youngest son of a powerful crime family is drawn into taking over the family business.

clues.quote: You're gonna need a bigger boat.
clues.plot: A police chief, a marine scientist and a grizzled fisherman hunt a great white shark terrorising a beach town.

clues.quote: May the Force be with you.
clues.plot: A farm boy joins a smuggler, a princess and an old knight to destroy a planet-killing space station.
A writer takes a winter caretaker job at an isolated hotel and slowly loses his mind.
A lonely boy hides a stranded alien in his bedroom and helps it contact its home.
A cyborg assassin is sent back in time to kill the woman who will give birth to a future resistance leader.
Three out-of-work scientists start a business catching ghosts in New York City.

clues.quote: Roads? Where we're going, we don't need roads.
clues.plot: A teenager is accidentally sent thirty years into the past in a time-travelling sports car and must get his parents together.

clues.quote: I feel the need... the need for speed!
clues.plot: A cocky naval aviator competes with the best fighter pilots at an elite flight school.
An off-duty New York cop is the only thing standing between terrorists and the hostages in a Los Angeles office tower on Christmas Eve.

clues.quote: Keep the change, ya filthy animal.
clues.plot: A boy accidentally left behind when his family flies to Paris defends the house against two burglars.
Visitors to an island theme park full of cloned dinosaurs find the security system has failed.

clues.quote: Life is like a box of chocolates.
clues.plot: A kind-hearted man with a low IQ unwittingly takes part in several defining moments of American history.
A young lion prince flees his kingdom after his father's death, then returns to challenge his uncle.
A pull-string cowboy doll's place as a boy's favourite toy is threatened by a new space ranger action figure.

clues.quote: I'm the king of the world!
clues.plot: A young artist and an engaged aristocrat fall in love aboard a doomed ocean liner on its maiden voyage.
A hacker learns that reality is a simulation and joins a rebellion against the machines that run it.
A betrayed Roman general is sold into slavery and rises through the arena to take revenge on the emperor.
An anxious clownfish and a forgetful blue tang cross the ocean to rescue his son from a dentist's fish tank.
A masked vigilante faces a chaotic, face-painted criminal who wants to push Gotham City into anarchy.
A thief who steals secrets from people's dreams is hired to plant an idea in a target's mind.
A fearless princess sets out to find her sister, whose icy powers have trapped their kingdom in eternal winter.
A poor family schemes its way into the lives and household of a wealthy one, with unforeseen consequences.
A doll living in a perfect pink world is forced to travel to the real one after developing an existential crisis.

clues.quote: Now I am become Death, the destroyer of worlds.
clues.plot: The physicist who led the wartime effort to build the first atomic bomb faces the consequences of his creation.

clues.quote: Lucy, you got some 'splainin' to do!
clues.plot: A scheming housewife constantly tries to break into her bandleader husband's show business world.
A time-travelling alien who regenerates into a new face roams space and time in a police box.

clues.quote: To boldly go where no man has gone before.
clues.plot: The crew of a starship explores strange new worlds under the command of a daring captain.
Army surgeons use humour to cope with the daily horrors of a field hospital during the Korean War.
The regulars and staff of a Boston bar share their ups and downs.
An animated family of five lives in a yellow-skinned town where the dad works at a nuclear power plant.
A stand-up comedian and his neurotic friends in New York turn the smallest of annoyances into epic sagas.
Six twenty-somethings navigate love, careers and a coffee house couch in Manhattan.
A New Jersey mob boss balances his criminal empire with therapy sessions and family drama.
Survivors of a plane crash on a mysterious tropical island discover they are not alone.
A mockumentary crew follows the everyday lives of paper company employees in Scranton, Pennsylvania.

clues.quote: I am the one who knocks.
clues.plot: A struggling chemistry teacher diagnosed with cancer starts cooking methamphetamine to provide for his family.
Noble families wage war for control of a fantasy continent's Iron Throne as an ancient threat gathers in the north.
In a 1980s Indiana town, a group of kids and a girl with psychic powers face a parallel dimension called the Upside Down.
Hundreds of debt-ridden contestants risk their lives in deadly children's games for a huge cash prize.
